title: Four won't fit
goalLine: Find the largest set of arrows that can be reliably told apart.

hints.text: Arrows must be 180 degrees apart to be told apart reliably.
One look gives one answer: at most 2 arrows can be completely distinguished.

events.reader-confused: Four arrows cannot fit without confusing the reader.

removePhysicsNote: Without opposite dial states, one look could never reliably tell two messages apart.
